connector.name: Multi-Account Gmail
connector.registryDescription: Multi-account Gmail MCP server - read, search, draft, and label across every inbox.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package multi-account-gmail-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cunicopia-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GMAIL_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Path to the Google OAuth "Desktop app" client-secret JSON. Defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/client_secret.json.

env.name: GMAIL_MCP_DB
env.description: Path to the SQLite token store holding per-account refresh tokens. Defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/tokens.db.

env.name: GMAIL_MCP_OAUTH_PORT
env.description: Localhost port for the OAuth redirect during account authorization. Defaults to 8765.
